maintenance_led.reason: Revenue is from recurring broadband subscriptions, billboard advertising rentals and surety premiums, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Broadband paid by households and businesses; billboards by advertisers; surety premiums by private contractors.

serial_acquirer.reason: Holding company that acquired broadband, billboard and surety units, but now grows mostly by building fiber and organic operations.

mission_critical.reason: Broadband and billboards are larger; consumers and advertisers can switch providers fairly easily, though fiber installs add some friction.

notes: Broadband and billboards are the larger segments; the serial-acquirer and mission-critical answers are judgment calls.
